```sql
WITH fy_dates AS (
    SELECT '2025-04-01'::date AS start_date, '2026-03-31'::date AS end_date
),

fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),

-- 1. POS Channel
pos_lines AS (
    SELECT
        t.txn_date AS tx_date,
        t.sku,
        t.quantity,
        (t.line_total - COALESCE(t.discount_amount, 0)) AS net_amount,
        s.country
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
      AND t.is_valid = true
      AND t.txn_type IN ('SALE', 'REFUND')
),
pos_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        p.tx_date,
        p.sku,
        p.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN p.country = 'Australia' THEN p.net_amount * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE p.net_amount
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM pos_lines p
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON p.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON p.tx_date = fx.rate_date
),
pos_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'POS' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM pos_mapped
),

-- 2. Web Shop Channel
ecom_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_date, currency, region_code
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
      AND order_status != 'CANCELLED'
),
ecom_lines_base AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_date,
        l.sku,
        l.quantity,
        (l.line_total - COALESCE(l.discount_amount, 0)) AS net_amount,
        o.region_code
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN ecom_orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
),
ecom_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_date,
        e.sku,
        e.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.region_code LIKE 'AU%' THEN e.net_amount * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE e.net_amount
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM ecom_lines_base e
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON e.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),
ecom_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Web Shop' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM ecom_mapped
),

-- 3. Wholesale Channel (ERP Sales Orders)
erp_lines_base AS (
    SELECT
        l.order_date,
        l.material_id,
        l.quantity,
        l.net_value,
        c.country
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
),
erp_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_date,
        e.net_value,
        e.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.country = 'Australia' THEN e.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE e.net_value
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM erp_lines_base e
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON e.material_id = m.material_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),
erp_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Wholesale' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM erp_mapped
),

combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM pos_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ecom_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM erp_agg
)

SELECT sales_channel AS answer
FROM combined
WHERE costed_revenue > 0
ORDER BY (gross_profit / costed_revenue) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
